context_requirements: Expression of cysteinyl leukotriene receptors (CYSLTR1/CYSLTR2) or BLT receptors (LTB4R/LTB4R2) on the assayed cell line
Presence of an autocrine or exogenous leukotriene stimulus to antagonise
Leukotriene-driven transcriptional programme active at baseline
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple lines that is reversed by leukotriene receptor agonists
Evidence of CYSLTR1/CYSLTR2 or LTB4R/LTB4R2 expression and functional coupling in these lines combined with a measurable response
